reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replaces the conversation model selector with a provider-grouped model panel and a three-level reasoning-effort slider, using host model-directory and session-selection services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话输入区提供按提供商分组的模型选择面板和三档推理档位滑块。
summaries.en: Adds a provider-grouped model selection panel and a three-level reasoning-effort slider to the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation input.

capabilities: Replaces the conversation model-selection UI slot
Displays models grouped by provider in a popup panel
Allows users to select among available reasoning effort levels
Reads model and effort options from the host model directory
Submits selected effort IDs through the host session selection service
Embeds and displays local avatar images in the browser UI
